```{r, libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```

WGA and cell viability

```{r}
TB_wga <- fread("wga_viability_trypanblue.csv")

ggplot(data = TB_wga, aes(x = Cellline, y = Viability, color = Treatments)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  ylim(0,100) +
  ylab("Viability (%)") +
  xlab("Cell lines") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line()
  )

# ggsave(plot = TB_box, filename = 'pdfs_man/boxplot_viability.pdf')


art_model <- art(Viability ~ as.factor(Cellline) * as.factor(Treatments), data = TB_wga)
anova(art_model)

```

Mechanical vs. enzymatic detachment (FACS)

```{r}
FACS_wga <- fread("wga_detachment_facs.csv")
FACS_wga$Treatment <- factor(FACS_wga$Treatment, levels = c("Scraped", "Accutase", "Trypsin"))

ggplot(data = FACS_wga, aes(x = Cellline, y = WGA_mean_MFI, color = Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,2)) +
  ylab("WGA-AF594 (Normalized MFI)") +
  xlab("Cell lines") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line()
  )

# ggsave('pdfs_man/boxplot_detachmentMethods.pdf')

fit <- lmer(WGA_mean_MFI ~ Treatment + (1 | Cellline), data = FACS_wga)

summary(fit)
```

PI vs. Hoechst staining

```{r}

conditions <- fread("wga_stainings_meta.csv")
conditions[,Condition := factor(Condition, levels = c("a", "b", "c", "g", "d", "h", "e", "f", "i", "j"))]
conditions_mat <- conditions[,c("Condition", "WGA-Streptavidin", "WGA", "Biotin", "sbRNA")]

conditions_long <- melt(conditions_mat, id.vars = "Condition", measure.vars = c(2:5), variable.name = "condition", value.name = "presence")
setnames(conditions_long, "Condition", "id")

# condition matrix

p_mat <- ggplot(conditions_long, aes(id, condition)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(presence)), size = 3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 1, "1" = 16)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 1))

# plot

pi <- ggplot(data = conditions[Intensity_MeanIntensity_PI != 0], 
       aes(x = Condition,
           y = Intensity_MeanIntensity_PI)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(transform = "log10", limits = c(1e-06, 1), breaks = 10^seq(-6, 0, by = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "PI mean intensity",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") + 
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 1))

dna <- ggplot(data = conditions, 
       aes(x = Condition,
           y = Intensity_MeanIntensity_DNA)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(transform = "log10", limits = c(1e-06, 1), breaks = 10^seq(-6, 0, by = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)))  +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "Hoechst 33342 mean intensity",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") + 
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 1))

pi / p_mat + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))

# ggsave("pdfs_man/boxplot_PI.pdf")

dna / p_mat + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))

# ggsave("pdfs_man/boxplot_DNA.pdf")

```
